sentences.text: Amelia Mary Earhart -LRB- -LSB- ˈɛərhɑrt -RSB- July 24 , 1897 -- disappeared July 2 , 1937 -RRB- was an American aviation pioneer and author .	aviation pioneer	aviation pioneer	disappeared	List of aerial disappearances
Earhart was the first female aviator to fly solo across the Atlantic Ocean .	fly solo across the Atlantic Ocean	transatlantic flight	the first female aviator	women in aviation
She received the U.S. Distinguished Flying Cross for this accomplishment .	Distinguished Flying Cross	Distinguished Flying Cross (United States)

She set many other records , wrote best-selling books about her flying experiences and was instrumental in the formation of The Ninety-Nines , an organization for female pilots .	The Ninety-Nines	Ninety-Nines
In 1935 , Earhart became a visiting faculty member at Purdue University as an advisor to aeronautical engineering and a career counselor to women students .	Purdue University	Purdue University
She was also a member of the National Woman 's Party and an early supporter of the Equal Rights Amendment .	Equal Rights Amendment	Equal Rights Amendment

During an attempt to make a circumnavigational flight of the globe in 1937 in a Purdue-funded Lockheed Model 10 Electra , Earhart disappeared over the central Pacific Ocean near Howland Island .	Howland Island	Howland Island	Lockheed Model 10 Electra	Lockheed Model 10 Electra	disappeared	List of aerial disappearances
Fascination with her life , career and disappearance continues to this day .
